headline: Three Largest Chinese Airlines Ended the Half-Year at a Loss Due to Rising Fuel Prices
summary: The three largest Chinese airlines ended the half-year at a combined loss of about 8.17 billion yuan, or 1.2 billion dollars, due to rising fuel prices. The airlines had warned of the loss in July.
why: Fuel is one of the largest operating costs for airlines, so jet fuel price increases quickly erode their margins.
